title: Three pizzas
explanation: The playful, picture-making taglines match the two examples in the order. A layout alone, as in Option C, would not carry the style. That is the Show the Plate recipe, Station 03.
output:
Margherita Moon | Basil, tomato, and a cheesy glow.
Pepper Parade | Sweet peppers dancing on a crisp crust.
Garden Gold | Sunny corn and spinach, warm from the oven.
